name: Mercury Insurance Services, LLC
desc:
Customer Support Specialist | $17.25/hr (Oklahoma pay tier) | Inbound, No Sales Expectations
Company: Mercury Insurance
Industry: Insurance
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 You'd be handling all kinds of customer conversations, phone, chat, text, email, even social media, helping people with basic policy questions, billing issues, and new claims. Some days you're explaining a bill or a coverage detail, other days you're processing a policy change or helping someone reset their account. You'd also work behind the scenes with agents, mortgage companies, and vendors to sort out bigger issues when something's not adding up. It's a variety-heavy customer service role where you're using real judgment, not just reading a script, since you're working across multiple communication channels and policy topics in the same shift.
assessment: expect an assessment; some form of typing or skills evaluation during the process is possible.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent, some college preferred
Required Experience: Minimum 1 year of customer service or call center experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Preferred Experience: High volume call experience, prior remote work experience
Required Skills:
Proficiency in Word, Excel, and Outlook
Minimum typing speed of 30 WPM
Strong written and verbal communication, including active listening
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills
Ability to multitask across multiple inquiry types with attention to detail
Ability to accept feedback and stay consistent with deadlines and performance standards
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with at least a year of customer service or call center experience who wants variety across chat, phone, text, and email
Someone who enjoys real problem solving, not just reading from a script
Someone comfortable multitasking across several communication channels
Someone who can commit to a fixed 40-hour schedule that includes a Saturday shift
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone who cannot commit to working Saturdays as part of the fixed schedule
Anyone below the 30 WPM typing requirement
Anyone who needs a role limited to a single communication channel
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Customer service
Insurance policy support
Billing and claims
Multi-channel support (phone, chat, email)
Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook
Problem resolution
Policy processing
Active listening
Attention to detail
Remote customer service
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview (an in-person interview may also be required)
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average. Next training class starts September 21, 2026.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about a time you handled a customer issue across more than one communication channel, like starting in chat and moving to a phone call.
How do you stay accurate and organized when multitasking between several customer inquiries at once?
Walk us through how you'd explain a billing or policy detail to a customer who's confused or frustrated.
This role includes a required Saturday shift, how do you feel about that kind of schedule?
What's your experience level with Word, Excel, and Outlook in a fast-paced work setting?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $17.25 per hour for Oklahoma-based employees (pay varies by state, with higher tiers in other states)
Shift: Paid training runs 4 weeks, Monday through Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm CST (converted from 7am to 4pm PST as listed in the posting). After training, a fixed 40-hour weekly schedule applies, which includes a Saturday shift
Benefits: Paid time off including vacation, sick time, 9 paid holidays, and volunteer hours, incentive bonus programs, medical, dental, vision, life, and pet insurance, 401(k) with company match, education assistance, and mental wellbeing resources including free therapy and coaching sessions
Equipment Provided: Not specified in the posting, and no internet requirement is listed either. Confirm both during the recruiter screen
Felony Friendly?: Not stated
Drug Test: Not stated
Notes: This is a strong opportunity for a participant who wants variety in their day and enjoys problem solving across different communication styles, not just phone calls. The company culture and benefits look genuinely solid, especially the mental wellbeing perks and education assistance. Just make sure participants know upfront about the required Saturday shift and the possibility of an in-person interview step.
Career Pathway: Customer Support Specialist → Senior Customer Support Specialist → Team Lead or Claims Support Specialist
